name: [Portal] Portal administrators — list, invite, roles, revoke (UI)
description:
**Why?**
The company entity + CQRS (invite/revoke/role-change commands) lands in `002-partner-company.md`. Figma (US-06/US-07) specifies reusing the _existing_ Shoptet "Nastavení / Správci obchodu" admin pattern, extended with login-history/action-log tabs and a live-revocation edge case not yet covered by the existing drafts.

**What?**
Build the "Nastavení / Správci portálu" page set per Figma ([node 41:311](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=41-311)): list, add user, edit user (role change), delete user, and the mid-session access-revocation redirect.

**Acceptance Criteria**

- [ ] User list + login-history tabs are backed by the existing `project_users_synchronization` table (`database/schema/st_cms.sql:2162` — already carries `loginCount`/`lastLogin`/`isPartner`/`isFounder`/`isOwner` per project+adminUser), kept in sync via `ProjectUsersSync` (`cms/packages/Synchronization/Users/ProjectUsersSync.php`) — not a new read-model
- [ ] Add-user flow (321:13256) wired to `InviteCompanyMemberCommand`
- [ ] Edit-user/role-change flow (655:44975) wired to `ChangeCompanyMemberRoleCommand`
- [ ] Delete-user flow (657:51031) wired to `RevokeCompanyMembershipCommand`
- [ ] A user whose access is revoked while actively in the portal is redirected out immediately (frame 447:26797), not just blocked on next login
- [ ] Page and all actions gated to `partnerCompanyRole='admin'`
- [ ] `make fe-test` covers list, add, edit, delete

**Resources**

- Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=41-311&m=dev
- Backend: `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/002-partner-company.md`, `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/005-account-surfaces.md`
- Existing per-project user read-model: `database/schema/st_cms.sql:2162` (`project_users_synchronization`), `cms/packages/Synchronization/Users/ProjectUsersSync.php`
- Admin page registration pattern: `migrations/2023/cms/LOG-83/section_map_add.sql`
